custom_xml.title: Enter custom firmware template
custom_xml.description:
You selected 'Custom' as the message format. Please paste the complete XML template from your heating's SD card below.

How to obtain it:
1. Enable SD logging on the touch screen of your Hargassner heating.
2. Insert an SD card into the heating, wait a few seconds, then remove it.
3. On your computer, open the DAQ00000.DAQ file from the card with a text editor.
4. Copy everything from <DAQPRJ> to </DAQPRJ> (including both tags) and paste it into the field below.
